Dr. Narayan should be more careful in future while taking actions, more so when she is aware that the matter is sub-judice. Dr. Narayan is advised to ensure that the steps taken by her should not result in overreaching any issue pending before the Court. 
4. The application is disposed of. 
W.P.(C) 15672/2023 1. On 10.04.2024, this Court reserved the matter for judgment. 2. The writ petition is disposed of as having rendered infructuous, along with pending application(s), if any.
